bind_address.description: The local IP address the Teredo server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

udp_port.description: UDP port used for Teredo traffic. Standard IANA-assigned port is 3544.

interface.description: Network interface name to bind to (e.g., eth0). Leave empty to auto-detect.

client_prefix.description: The IPv6 prefix assigned to Teredo clients. Must be a /32 or /48 block, and not conflict with existing subnets.

server_address.description: Public IPv4 address of this Teredo server, as seen by clients. Auto-detected if empty, but explicit is recommended.

enable_syslog.description: If true, logs are sent to the system syslog daemon.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging. Accepts: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent Teredo clients supported.

min_refresh.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between client keep-alive messages.

max_refresh.description: Maximum interval (seconds) between client keep-alive messages. Must be > min_refresh.

nat_traversal.description: If true, attempt automatic NAT discovery using NAT-PMP or UPnP (if available).

relays.description: List of upstream Teredo relay servers (public or private) for redundancy.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the relay server.

port.description: UDP port of the relay server. Standard is 3544.
